figurative_meaning_en: A large number of unwanted and annoying people
example_sentences_in_bangla: পাড়ায় গুষ্টি এসে উপদ্রব শুরু করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The gang has come to the neighborhood and started causing trouble.
Seeing that horde makes me annoyed.
note: The idiom often implies a collective nuisance, rooted in everyday Bengali social interactions.
